Title: Passages test
Subject: History
1. Which building style is shown in the picture? {mcq}
[diagram: page 2 — photograph of a building with columns]
a) Gothic
b) Classical
c) Baroque
d) Modern
Read the following extract from a fictional town charter, written in 1520.
"The town council shall meet every month. Each district shall send two members, one merchant and one craftsman, and no tax may be raised without the council's consent."
2. The charter best shows which idea? {mcq}
a) Royal absolutism
b) Shared local government
c) Religious toleration
d) Free trade
3. Which group sent members to the council? {mcq} {cols: 2}
a) Priests
b) Merchants and craftsmen
c) Soldiers
d) Farmers
